title: Station single-camera interaction event
description: One model-opinion event in events.json. Events remain unconfirmed until human review. The source video and run directory provide the event's scope. The application validates source-relative time bounds and start_ms <= end_ms.

id.description: Event ID within this run, for example e0001. It is not globally unique.

person_id.description: Anonymous track label from this video's allowed person IDs, for example P001. Null means the actor is unknown or attribution conflicts. It is not a person's name or a cross-camera identity.

start_ms.description: Start time relative to the source video in milliseconds, rounded by basic_event. It must not exceed end_ms.

end_ms.description: End time relative to the source video in milliseconds, rounded by basic_event. The application validates it against the source duration.

action.description: shelf_interaction: a continuous person/layer operation session for retrieval; it does not by itself confirm parcel pickup or removal. Other values are retained for the legacy take/put pipeline. Pickup opinions and uncalibrated scores are in session details.

shelf_level.description: Bottom-up storage-board number: the lowest storage board is 1, the top storage board is included, and the floor is excluded. For shelf_interaction use the operation region; algorithm/model disagreement is recorded in details and stays null here. For legacy take use the original support; for put use the destination support. Null means unknown, conflicting or not applicable. This bound is not a claim that the scene contains 20 levels.
